title: Angara credits teachers, personnel as basic public ed tops survey

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Education Secretary Sonny Angara credited public school teachers and field personnel nationwide for basic public education emerging as the highest-rated government service in the latest Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey for the third quarter of 2026. The national survey, conducted from Sept. 21 to 27, 2026, found that “providing youth with basic education in public elementary and high schools” earned a +61 net satisfaction rating, which is classified by SWS as “very good.” Meanwhile, “improving the quality of children’s education” registered a +50 net satisfaction score, which is also classified as “very good.” READ: DepEd: Public school direct funding […]...
